CRPF DIG Suspended Over Social Media Posts on CAPF Act

A Deputy Inspector General (DIG) of the Central Reserve Police Force (CRPF) has been suspended. The suspension follows the sharing of content on social media that was described as 'anti-government' and critical of the CAPF Act. Centrist outlets reported that the officer had written about 'changing the government' on social media. The action highlights the regulations concerning government employees' conduct on social media regarding official policies.
